title.why: The Japanese title appears in the Cabinet Office list of ministry guidelines stored for JP-05 (row 1, under 総務省、経済産業省). Literally 'AI business-operator guidelines'; 'AI Guidelines for Business' is a fair rendering and, per the web lead, the ministries' own English title, but no English version is stored, so it is not graded as the official English title.

summary_claims.claim: Single set of voluntary AI governance guidelines for AI developers, providers and business users.
summary_claims.locator: 各府省庁等のガイドライン等の一覧, row 1 (AI事業者ガイドライン), 概要 column
summary_claims.original_quote: 様々な事業活動においてＡＩの開発・提供・利用を担う全ての者に対し、ＡＩ開発・提供・利用にあたって必要な取組についての基本的な考え方を示すもの。
summary_claims.literal_translation: It sets out, for all those who carry out the development, provision or use of AI in various business activities, the basic approach to the efforts needed in AI development, provision and use.

summary_claims.claim: It sets common principles (human-centricity, safety, fairness, privacy, security, transparency, accountability and others) and recommends risk-based, agile AI governance across the life cycle.
It includes specific guidance for advanced AI systems based on the Hiroshima AI Process.
